description:
Any Minute Now makes animated what-if stories about time. In every video, one impossible thing happens with time in your normal life, and we follow it all the way to what it really costs you.

What if you sold a year of your life? What if you slept for 100 years? What if you could go back and undo one decision? You start on an ordinary morning, at home, at school or on your street. Then the clock does something it should not do, and you have to live with the result.

The stories are imagined, but the science inside them is real and checked. You will find time loops, time travel, ageing, memory, stopping time, skipping time and the far future, always through one person: you.

These videos are made for a general audience of curious people who like to play along with a strange idea and think about what they would do. All of them are about the one thing nobody can get more of.

New stories go up here regularly. Subscribe if you want to see what happens next. It could be any minute now.
